queries.INFO: UPDATE torrents t LEFT JOIN (SELECT p.torrent_id,SUM(p.active=1 AND p.visible=1 AND p.seeder=1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM peer_ips e WHERE e.user_id=p.user_id AND e.torrent_id=p.torrent_id AND e.peer_id=p.peer_id)) AS seeders,SUM(p.active=1 AND p.visible=1 AND p.seeder=0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM peer_ips e WHERE e.user_id=p.user_id AND e.torrent_id=p.torrent_id AND e.peer_id=p.peer_id)) AS leechers,SUM(p.active=1 AND p.visible=1 AND p.seeder=1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM peer_ips e WHERE e.user_id=p.user_id AND e.torrent_id=p.torrent_id AND e.peer_id=p.peer_id AND e.family=4)) AS seeders_ipv4,SUM(p.active=1 AND p.visible=1 AND p.seeder=1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM peer_ips e WHERE e.user_id=p.user_id AND e.torrent_id=p.torrent_id AND e.peer_id=p.peer_id AND e.family=6)) AS seeders_ipv6,SUM(p.active=1 AND p.visible=1 AND p.seeder=0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM peer_ips e WHERE e.user_id=p.user_id AND e.torrent_id=p.torrent_id AND e.peer_id=p.peer_id AND e.family=4)) AS leechers_ipv4,SUM(p.active=1 AND p.visible=1 AND p.seeder=0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM peer_ips e WHERE e.user_id=p.user_id AND e.torrent_id=p.torrent_id AND e.peer_id=p.peer_id AND e.family=6)) AS leechers_ipv6 FROM peers p GROUP BY p.torrent_id) c ON c.torrent_id=t.id SET t.seeders=COALESCE(c.seeders,0),t.leechers=COALESCE(c.leechers,0),t.seeders_ipv4=COALESCE(c.seeders_ipv4,0),t.seeders_ipv6=COALESCE(c.seeders_ipv6,0),t.leechers_ipv4=COALESCE(c.leechers_ipv4,0),t.leechers_ipv6=COALESCE(c.leechers_ipv6,0)
